meta.title: wisspop — Origin-anchored modals & dropdowns
meta.description: Modals, dropdowns, and selects with origin-anchored animations: the panel originates from the element that opened it and returns to it when closed.
hero.description: Mini-library for modals, dropdowns, and selects with origin-anchored animations. The panel doesn't pop out of nowhere; it grows out of the element that triggered it and morphs back upon closing.
sidebar.title: On this page
docs.intro_p1: Standard modals fade in or scale up from the center of the viewport. While functional, it breaks visual continuity: the user clicks a button on one side of the screen and a dialog appears somewhere else without spatial relation.
docs.intro_p2: wisspop maintains spatial continuity. The panel starts with the exact position, size, and border-radius of the button that opened it, growing smoothly into its final form. Upon closing, it reverses the transition. The eye seamlessly follows the object without losing context.
docs.install_p: Install wisspop using your preferred package manager:
docs.morph_desc: The box grows from the trigger button's rectangle to its final size. Content fades in smoothly with blur and staggered timing.
docs.pill_desc: Same as MorphModal, but the button text physically travels across the screen to land directly onto the modal heading element marked with data-wisspop-title.
docs.flip_desc: Real FLIP transition: multiple individual elements (images, badges, titles) marked with data-flip-id travel from the trigger to the expanded modal.
docs.dropdown_desc: The panel expands vertically with an elastic bounce starting right from the button edge.
docs.opciones_desc: Configure placement (top, bottom, left, right, origin, center, drawer-left), alignment, gap, scroll locking, and callbacks.
docs.frameworks_desc: Zero-dependency core (Pure JS + GSAP) wrapped with lightweight adapters for Vue and React.
docs.a11y_desc: Includes automatic focus trap, Escape key listener, focus restoration, body scroll locking, reduced motion support, and ARIA roles.
